name: change-communication
summary: Tell the people on a system what changed, what it costs them, and what to do — sized to how much it actually costs them.

when: a deprecation has to be announced
a breaking change is going out

steps: Lead with what the reader has to DO. A release note that opens with what the team built makes every reader hunt for their own line.
Size the message to the cost. A patch does not need a migration guide and a breaking change is not a changelog line.
For anything breaking: the before, the after, the codemod if there is one, and the date the old path stops working.
Say what you are NOT changing. Half of the anxiety in a release note is about things that were never at risk.
No emoji, in the note or in the headings.
output: The note, ordered by what the reader must do.
done: the first line tells the reader whether they have to act
anything breaking names a date and a path
